title: Brief Optimization Report
description: What skills/brief-optimization.md changed when turning a page brief, PRD or ticket into a design-ready ticket brief, and why. Shown to the author before generation; nothing in the optimized brief is hidden from them.

sourceRef.description: The author's document (path or link). Never modified.

briefRef.description: ticketKey of the optimized ticket brief.

changes.description: Every rewrite, from the author's wording to the optimized wording.

kind.description: Which optimization rule produced it (skills/brief-optimization.md, 'Fit it to the design system').

section.description: Section of the source it came from.

reason.description: The rule, token or threshold behind it, e.g. 'vocabulary map: pop → hierarchy; color.usagePolicy.maxPrimaryActionsPerScreen'.

confirmed.description: Set once the author accepts it. Inferred items must be confirmed before the brief is ready.

conflicts.description: Requests that break a design-system rule. Never resolved silently.

rule.description: The manifest field or principle it conflicts with.

componentHints.description: Approved components that likely cover each required element: input to the reuse check (Step 3), not a decision.

relatedDesigns.description: Design-index projects the brief's terms or surfaces touch; the scope check (Step 2b) decides.

readiness.description: 'ready' only when no questions are open, every conflict is accepted, and every inferred change is confirmed.

approvedBy.description: Who approved the optimized brief, when briefPolicy.approvalBeforeGeneration is true.
